_help: Map a machine_type (oven, autoclave, press, cnc, spray_booth, vacuum_pump, injection, dispenser, cutting, hand_tool, packaging) or an exact machine name to a glTF/GLB file in this folder. Options: rotateX/rotateZ/rotateY in degrees (rotateX -90 for Z-up CAD exports; rotateY turns the machine on the floor), height in metres, credit (shown on the twin page; required for CC BY models). Models are scaled to the machine's footprint. After editing run: cd tools && npm run models
